claim_scope: Development-only audit of pyddx/ddPCM as a fixed-charge polar provider. The audit covers label-blind numerical convergence, one complete Cartesian force check, one local timing trace, and a 526-molecule fixed-geometry FreeSolv development screen. It is not independent confirmation, a sampled hydration free energy, or a production-provider admission.
